ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (32) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Раб» (rab, 'slave') is rendered 'slave' both in Luke 17 and in the closing thought, which echoes it; «начало» (nachalo) is 'source' ('the source that gave you life'). The Laozi sentence on the seeker of virtue is printed after the attribution, outside the quotation, and is translated where it stands.
Source observation: [5] «пащущего» is a one-letter slip for «пашущего» (pashushchego, 'plowing'); translated in that sense

Source observation: [30] the Laozi sentence «Тот, кто ищет добродетели…» (Tot, kto ishchet dobrodeteli, 'He who seeks virtue…') is printed after the attribution [29] and outside the quotation; by sense it belongs between [27] and [28] (Laozi 48). Translated where printed
